About Me

I'm Oladeji Opeyemi

I'm a professional web developer based in Ibadan, Oyo State, Nigeria. I specialise in building complete, functional web systems — not just attractive pages — for businesses that need real digital tools to grow and operate.

From fintech PWAs and e-commerce platforms to hotel booking engines, hospital management systems, school portals, and real estate platforms, I build systems that solve real problems for real organisations across Nigeria.

Every project I deliver is coded from scratch, fully mobile-responsive, Firebase-powered, and built with the Nigerian market in mind — WhatsApp integration, Paystack payments, and systems that work perfectly on every Android phone.

I have delivered 22+ live projects across 8+ industries, with 10 projects on custom domains — proof that real clients trust me with real money and real businesses.
